title: R4b fixed restart target and preflight metadata
description: Pure closed metadata contract only. Stable target plan for the sole candidate mcs.standalone/effects profile mcs.standalone.restart.v1. This schema does not register or authorize a service and provides no signature, approval, local receipt, grant, dispatch, execution or completion capability. Existing R4a diagnostic schema/validator/vectors remain separate and unchanged. No path, PID, label, argv, shell, URL, patient information or free text is accepted. Raw JSON uses strict UTF-8/duplicate rejection, no BOM, depth <=8, ASCII CJSON and safe integers, maximum16384 bytes.
$comment: Runtime requires the exact independent expected_scope object and exact current plan/witness bindings. The plan deliberately has no creation/expiry time and may be confirmed before a later fresh preflight; it is stable metadata, not a long-lived execution permission. A changed runtime generation conflicts with the approved target. runtime_generation names the managed service runtime instance (hyphenless lowercase UUIDv4), distinct from R4a operation admission owner_generation. Machine shape cannot prove current owner observation, side effects, local consent, authorization, one-use grant, owner drain CAS, durable receipt or causal completion. Remote availability remains disabled until the separate owner and operational gates pass.

runtime_generation.description: 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters encoding UUIDv4 without hyphens; this is the managed service runtime generation, not an operation admission token.

timestamp.description: Nonnegative safe UTC epoch milliseconds. Runtime additionally rejects negative zero.

preflight.$comment: Runtime requires independent full expected scope and a previously validated restart plan. Product/full scope/service/runtime_generation must match that plan. now is a required nonnegative safe UTC millisecond integer (not negative zero); started_at <= observed_at <= now and now-observed_at <=15000. owner_alive must be true and update_in_progress/command_intake_in_progress/restarting must each be false for eligibility. Typed booleans have no defaults. These cross-field/freshness/plan/readiness checks are not established by JSON Schema. A preflight is a fresh witness for grant acquisition and again immediately before owner drain, not a snapshot retained during human approval.

expected_scope.description: All five fields are independently resolved authenticated target scope, never inferred from the submitted plan or witness. Required by both runtime validators.
